ui.demoNotice: Design preview with sample data. Buttons do not send email or change your account.
ui.actionNotice: Preview only. No email was sent and no account changes were made.
ui.footer: This email relates to your SosoAPI account or an action you requested.
ui.fallback: If the button does not work, open the secure link below.
ui.samplePost: A new season of ideas, inspired by the small moments around us.

verify.name: Confirm email
verify.subject: Please confirm your SosoAPI email address
verify.preview: Confirm your email address to complete your account setup.
verify.title: Please confirm your email address
verify.body: Thank you for registering with SosoAPI. Please confirm your email address to complete your account setup.
verify.note: This link can be used once and expires at {{verification_expiry}}. If you did not register for SosoAPI, you can ignore this email.

signin.name: Sign-in code
signin.subject: Your SosoAPI sign-in code
signin.preview: Use this one-time code to sign in.
signin.title: Your sign-in code
signin.body: Enter the code below in SosoAPI to finish signing in, or use the sign-in button.
signin.note: The code expires at {{code_expiry}}. Do not share this code or link. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

reset.name: Reset password
reset.subject: Reset your SosoAPI password
reset.preview: Choose a new password using this secure link.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset your SosoAPI password. Use the button below to choose a new password.
reset.note: This link can be used once and expires at {{reset_expiry}}. If you did not request a reset, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

security.name: Password changed
security.subject: Your SosoAPI password has been changed
security.preview: If you did not make this change, secure your account.
security.title: Your password has been changed
security.body: The password for your SosoAPI account has been changed. If you made this change, no further action is needed.
security.callout: If you did not make this change, reset your password and review your connected apps and account access.

activated.name: Subscription active
activated.subject: Your SosoAPI subscription is active
activated.preview: Your payment is confirmed and your subscription is active.
activated.title: Your subscription is active
activated.body: Your payment has been confirmed. Your updated subscription is now active for the workspace below.
activated.note: Our payment provider sends your official receipt separately. You can review your plan and invoices in Billing.

payment.name: Payment unsuccessful
payment.subject: Please update your SosoAPI payment method
payment.preview: We could not collect your subscription renewal payment.
payment.title: Your renewal payment was unsuccessful
payment.body: We could not collect your subscription renewal payment. Please update your payment method to keep your current access.
payment.note: If you have already resolved the payment, check Billing for the latest status. Never send card details by email.

cancel.name: Cancellation confirmed
cancel.subject: Your SosoAPI subscription cancellation is confirmed
cancel.preview: Your current plan remains available until the date below.
cancel.title: Your cancellation is confirmed
cancel.body: Automatic renewal has been turned off. You can continue using your current plan until the date below.
cancel.note: See Billing for the changes that apply when paid access ends. Cancelling your subscription does not delete your account.

invite.name: Team invitation
invite.subject: You are invited to join Studio on SosoAPI
invite.preview: Jamie has invited you to join the team.
invite.title: You are invited to join the team
invite.body: Jamie has invited you to collaborate in SosoAPI. Accept the invitation to access the workspace with the permissions shown below.
invite.note: Sign in with the email address that received this invitation. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

reconnect.name: Reconnect account
reconnect.subject: Please reconnect your Instagram account
reconnect.preview: Restore the connection to resume publishing access.
reconnect.title: Please reconnect your account
reconnect.body: We can no longer access your Instagram account. Please reconnect it to restore publishing access.
reconnect.note: After reconnecting, review the affected posts. Posts that already failed may need a separate recovery action.

failed.name: Post not published
failed.subject: Your Instagram post could not be published
failed.preview: The media file is unavailable. Your post content is saved.
failed.title: Your post could not be published
failed.body: Your scheduled Instagram post could not be published because the media file is no longer available. Your post content is still saved.
failed.note: Replace the media, review the post and choose a new publishing time. Opening this email will not resend the post.

uncertain.name: Publication unconfirmed
uncertain.subject: Please check whether your Instagram post was published
uncertain.preview: We could not confirm the result. Check before retrying.
uncertain.title: Publication could not be confirmed
uncertain.body: The platform did not return a clear result. Your post may already be live. Check the account before publishing it again.
uncertain.callout: To avoid a duplicate post, check the original post on Instagram before choosing a recovery action.

deletion.name: Deletion requested
deletion.subject: Your SosoAPI account deletion request
deletion.preview: You can restore your account before the deadline below.
deletion.title: Your deletion request has been received
deletion.body: Your account access is now paused. You can restore your account before the deadline below.
deletion.callout: Personal scheduled posts that have not started are cancelled, and subscription renewal is being stopped. Restoring the account does not automatically reschedule posts or restart renewal.
deletion.note: If you did not request this, restore your account, change your password and review connected apps. Permanent removal starts after the restore period.
